$comment: Brief 33 (ADR 0028): which activity failures the Durable layer retries. A rule names the failure's ErrorType (the full exception type name, TaskFailureDetails.ErrorType) and optionally narrows it: whenMessageMatches (a regex on ErrorMessage), whenPropertyIn (a value of a property the app's IExceptionPropertiesProvider adds; a SqlException's message never carries its number), innerIsTransient (classify the wrapped InnerFailure). Every regex and property here is written from captured failure details, not from memory: src/LossRun.Orchestration.Tests/fixtures/captured-failures.json, produced by tools/capture-failures. The chain is walked outermost first; the first rule that matches decides. Unknown types are not retried (the lower layers had their chance): they fail fast and reach the Needs-investigation queue keyed by their type. Grow the lists from that queue, with evidence; never flip unknownIsTransient.
